title: Uninspired crafts. Poor value.
text: For what you get, the Adults & Crafts subscription is not great. Basically, an 8-1/2 x 11 print-out of some things you can do with the contents included. If you remember Martha Stewart craft kits, this doesn't even come close in quality, ideas, or inspiration. For instance, one kit was "engraving" and came with a sheet of ugly clip art to trace onto items like a cheap stainless steel water bottle (the kind you can get for $1 almost anywhere, a metal chain and a glass coaster. Nothing you would be proud to display or give as a gift. MAYBE for kids, this kit would be okay, but I was expecting something more sophisticated as it is marketed to adults. You also do not get a reusable storage box or any way to keep the kit items together for future access. The card kit was similarly disappointing. The 8-1/2 x 11 project sheets aren't even nicely designed for saving in 3-ring binder. For the price, I truly expected higher quality in projects and materials. Also, with the subscription, you do not get an opportunity to know what is coming and skip months you don't want. I would recommend just buying a kit you're interested in vs. the subscription.
label: neutral
